description: List directory contents with flexible output formats. Replaces the previous list_directory, list_directory_with_sizes, and directory_tree tools. Supports simple listings, detailed views with sizes/timestamps, hierarchical tree display, and structured JSON output. Automatically filters globally configured ignored folders. Only works within allowed directories.

excludePatterns.description: Glob patterns to exclude (e.g., ['*.log', 'temp*']). Applied in addition to globally configured ignored folders.

format.description: Output format: 'simple' (basic listing), 'detailed' (with sizes and metadata), 'tree' (hierarchical text tree), 'json' (structured data)

path.description: Absolute path to the directory to list

sortBy.description: Sort by name (alphabetical) or size (largest first)

name: list_directory
